NCZ-OS screensavers

Captured from the real screensavers running on NCZ-OS. Nothing here is a mock-up, a film still or a photograph. Ships in 26.10 means the saver is in the 84-saver set. Approved means it has been approved and is on its way into that set. Candidate means it is shown for feedback and is not approved yet.

Black Hole

Ships in 26.10

A ray-traced black hole with a lensed accretion disk, photon ring, relativistic jets and a live star field. The default screensaver.

Engine
NCZ Black Hole engine (GLES3)
Settings
Palettes: stylized, kipthorne, faithful, singularity, slingshot, whitehole, eht (cygnus proposed). Presets such as Kerr, TON 618, Sagittarius A*, M87*.
Randomization
Each run draws a new seed: disk turbulence, camera path and star field differ every time. A fixed seed can be pinned for reproducible captures.

Black Hole: scenes and director camera

Approved

Binary pairs, a merger, a tidal disruption event, a galaxy zoom and a three-body dance, framed by a director camera that eases between shots.

Engine
NCZ Black Hole engine (GLES3), enhanced style
Settings
--style=enhanced or per-option scene, director, tonemap, disk-structure, jet-duty. Classic look stays the default.
Randomization
The director picks scenes and off-center framings per shot, so long runs do not repeat one composition.

Physarum

Approved

Pale strands drift and braid over deep blue, driven by a Physarum (slime-mold) trail simulation.

Engine
xshadertoy (original shader)
Settings
Mid GPU class and up.
Randomization
The xshadertoy engine hands every run a fresh random seed (iSeed), so each launch starts from a different state; how far a shader varies with it depends on the shader.

Neon Spacewar

Candidate

A self-playing 1980s-style vector space battle with neon glow. Version 2 (Melee: deterministic replays, framing camera, closing arena) is in progress.

Engine
NCZ original (GLES3 vector renderer)
Settings
Liked by the operator; not yet approved for shipping.
Randomization

Ephemeris

Candidate

Temporary workers slowly work a durable surface they only partly see. Nothing persists: each run exists once. Under active iteration.

Engine
NCZ original (GLES3)
Settings
Weak GPU class friendly; matte pigment, no glow.
Randomization
Every run is unique by design and is never repeated.
NCZ-OS 26.10 "Cygnus". All imagery is rendered by NCZ-OS screensaver code. The sizzle soundtrack is an original ambient bed generated for this page.
